profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software developer based in Denver, Colorado who focuses on writing clean, elegant, and efficient code. I enjoy coding things from scratch and watching my ideas come to life in the browser.

When I'm not coding, you'll probably find me in the mountains. I've learned many valuable life lessons in the great outdoors and these values — from pushing the boundaries of my comfort zone to taking one step at a time — translate from the trail to the workplace.

I am passionate about building software that is making a difference in the world. That's why I aspire to make a big impact at a high growth company where I can take on interesting projects with positive people. Let's build something great together.

Proficient: Java, JavaScript (ES6), React, Redux, HTML5, CSS3

GitHub: https://github.com/staycruzin
Portfolio: https://anthonycruz.me/

I look forward to connecting with you!

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered as a Hike Leader for the 2019 Trailblaze Challenge, a 28 mile hike (in one day!) to raise funds and awareness for the Make-A-Wish San Diego chapter. I helped get the participants ready for the big hike by leading training hikes and sharing my hiking knowledge. The event raised over $650,000 and I am so lucky to have been a part of it. I also participated in the event the previous year as a hiker, completing the 28 miles and raising over $2,000 in the process.
